name: Accenture

roles.name: Associate Software Engineer (ASE)
roles.note: Campus/off-campus role for B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA/MSc graduates per Accenture India campus listings. CTC was not shown on the listings found.

roles.name: Packaged App Development Associate
roles.note: Official listing names preferred skills such as ABAP on HANA, Salesforce configuration, J2EE and .NET.

rounds.name: Behavioural & Cognitive Assessment
rounds.what_they_check: Personality fit plus cognitive puzzles and numerical problems. Accenture's India campus support page lists ~40 minutes; sectional cut-offs must be cleared to move forward. Candidate reports sometimes describe a longer combined cognitive + technical test (~90 questions in ~90 minutes).
prep: Practise abstract and critical reasoning puzzles (patterns, series, matrices).
Revise quick arithmetic: percentages, ratios and simple data interpretation.
Answer personality items consistently and honestly rather than guessing the 'ideal' answer.

rounds.name: Technical Assessment
rounds.what_they_check: Broad IT fundamentals, as listed on Accenture's India campus support page (~45 minutes).
prep: Revise MS Excel/Word/PowerPoint features (formulas, shortcuts, formatting).
Practise pseudocode output questions on loops, arrays and recursion.
Revise networking basics (OSI, IP, DNS), security basics and cloud service models (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS).

rounds.name: Coding Assessment
rounds.what_they_check: Ability to solve problems in a backend, SQL or front-end language of your choice. Accenture's support page states 3 problems in 60 minutes; some 2024 candidate reports describe 2 easy problems, so expect variation by drive.
prep: Practise easy–medium array and string problems (reversal, frequency counts, sorting).
Be comfortable writing basic SQL queries, since SQL is an allowed option.
Practise on a HackerRank-style editor; Accenture's global page points to a HackerRank sample test.

rounds.name: Communication Assessment
rounds.what_they_check: Spoken and written English (pronunciation, fluency, sentence mastery, vocabulary). The support page says about 30 minutes, with login details sent separately. Several secondary sources describe it as non-eliminatory, but do not rely on that.
prep: Practise reading passages aloud and repeating sentences clearly at a steady pace.
Use a quiet room and a working headset/microphone.
Practise short spoken answers and sentence-building drills.

rounds.name: Technical + HR Interview
rounds.what_they_check: Project understanding, programming fundamentals, aptitude to learn and communication. Secondary sources describe a technical interview followed by HR, sometimes combined.
prep: Prepare a clear explanation of your project, tools used and your contribution.
Revise OOP, DBMS/SQL and one language's basics.
Prepare answers on relocation, shifts and why Accenture.

cutoffs.note: Not published; Accenture's India campus support page states that sectional cut-offs must be cleared to progress, but no percentage is published. Secondary sources mention sectional and sub-sectional cut-offs without reliable figures. Accenture's global page says a failed assessment cannot be retaken for at least 90 days.

cse_it.note: Coding assessment is part of the process for everyone; CSE/IT candidates should aim to solve all problems.

ece_eee.note: ASE listings name B.E/B.Tech degrees without a branch restriction in the summaries found (confirm on the listing). The same coding, technical and communication assessments apply.

mech_civil.note: Same assessment as other branches; focus on easy coding problems, SQL and the MS Office/networking/cloud basics in the technical assessment.

all.note: Official listings mention no active backlogs, limited (≤23–24 months) prior experience, and exclusion if you took an Accenture assessment/interview in the last 3 months. Pass-out batches vary by listing.

jd_skills.note: Cognitive puzzles in the behavioural & cognitive assessment.
Numerical problems in the cognitive assessment.
Networking and security fundamentals in the technical assessment.
Cloud fundamentals are listed as a technical assessment topic.
One language for the coding assessment (backend, SQL or front-end languages allowed).
SQL is an accepted coding option and common interview topic.
Dedicated communication assessment; listings ask for verbal and communication proficiency.
Listings ask for analytical and problem-solving skills.
J2EE/.NET named as preferred skills for Packaged App Development Associate.
Exposure to SAP ABAP or Salesforce is preferred, not required.

hr_focus: Willingness to relocate to any of Accenture's Indian delivery cities and to work in shifts.
Why Accenture and readiness to learn new platforms (SAP, Salesforce, cloud).
Eligibility checks: backlogs, pass-out year, prior Accenture assessments.
